text: {"question":"How does allowing the helium fraction to vary freely affect the precision of the CMB measurement of the baryon density compared to fixing it with a BBN-consistent value?","reference_answer":"When YHe is treated as a free parameter, the CMB determination of the baryon density ωb becomes about 1.4 times less precise than when YHe is fixed by BBN consistency. Including an independent measurement of YHe restores the precision to the level obtained with the BBN constraint."}
